$comment: Relevance judgements for the retrieval evaluation.
Each query names the archetypes whose members count as relevant. On the
synthetic corpus that mapping is ground truth: the generator built each
developer from exactly one archetype, so 'who should this query return' is
known rather than guessed. Run against a real GitHub corpus instead and
these labels no longer apply - see README for how to supply your own.
Queries are written the way a recruiter actually types them: some name a
technology directly (lexical should win), some describe the work without
naming the stack (vector should win). A benchmark made only of the first
kind would flatter lexical search and prove nothing about the hybrid.
